approvers: Site manager and glazing subcontractor; I sign
reason: The aluminium arrives with factory film and my lads put sheet and tape on for about €12 a m². You want €19 a m² for something I already handle, plus a 50% deposit up front. I don't see where that pays me back.
objection: It costs more than what I do today, and the 50% deposit and the minimum job size make it worse. Where is the saving, or the damage I actually avoid?
instead: Keep the factory film plus our own film, sheet and tape, applied and removed by our own labour.
would_change_my_mind: Hard proof on one of my own blocks that it cuts glazing and joinery damage claims by more than the extra cost, at or near €12 a m² all-in and with 60-day terms.
